Priority notes from initial triage (quick bullet findings):
- Observed increased GC/eviction hotspots on hosts serving long-window KV caches; memory churn correlates with p99 spikes.
- A subset of requests are forcing full attention recomputation due to mis-tagged prompt segments; these incur higher kernel switching overhead.
- Autoscaling buffered but cold-starts for large-context variants showed higher latency under bursty traffic.

Short-term mitigations pushed (now):
- Temporarily enabled strict prefix-KV reuse for compatible requests (reduces recompute for repeat prefixes).
- Activated conservative rate limiter on hosted route for 32k traffic tier to smooth bursts (soft cap, 2% throttling).
- Rolled a runtime tweak to defer some heavy kernel operations off the main path for >24k tokens (trade: slightly increased token cost vs stability).

I attached heap traces and p99 rollup for the last 6 hours. We should see an improvement within 30–45 minutes; please have BlackRock re-run their failing scenario.

-Dylan
